name: Kankeizu ~Yutori-kun no Gyakushuu~
original_name: 姦系図～ゆとり君の逆襲～
source:
Yutaka's father gets remarried and his new mother, Fumio, and sister, Kaori, come to his house. He does not agree with their marriage because his ex-mother committed suicide due to Fumio's existence. "I'll never forgive them...." He plans to rape Fumio and Kaori....

[From ErogeShop]
translation: 丰的父亲再婚了，新母亲文雄和继妹薰搬进了他的家。他无法接受这段婚姻，因为他的亲生母亲就是因为文雄的存在才自杀的。"我永远也不会原谅她们……"他计划强暴文雄和薰……\n\n[改编自ErogeShop]
